fields.label: Location
fields.note: Location popover checkbox list (data-component-name=jobs-filter-location); default is "All locations". City locations are printed on the cards but are not a filter control.

fields.label: Discipline
fields.note: Discipline dropdown (data-component-name=jobs-filter-discipline, value slugs engineering-data, design, product, ...).

notes: www.shopify.com/careers/jobs is a server-rendered React Router page that prints all 112 live roles in one response. Its controls (Search roles box, Location popover, Discipline select) are client-side only: requesting ?search=engineer&location=Remote+-+India&discipline=engineering-data returned the identical 112-role HTML, so there is no keyword/filter/sort request parameter to drive. No sort control is published. Filter on the collected rows locally.
evidence: https://www.shopify.com/careers/jobs (112 role links; controls data-component-name=jobs-filter-search / jobs-filter-location / jobs-filter-discipline)
https://www.shopify.com/careers/jobs?search=engineer&location=Remote+-+India&discipline=engineering-data -> same 112 role links, same byte size (client-side filtering)
Discipline options extracted from the jobs-filter-discipline select; location checkboxes from data-component-extra-location
